steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You don't look so good.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm fine, I was just thinking.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I didn't think he'd get dragged into this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't worry, you know how I am. It's all in the past now, or as we say in Lungmen, such is fate.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do people in the Far East believe in fate?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Having been through so many things, even if I didn't believe it before, I have to accept it now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Is the intel accurate?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Without a doubt. Here's the location indicated by the intel.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Those Reunion members skulking around... are they our targets?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: By the looks of things, they don't know that we've completely surrounded them yet.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They seem to be building something around the entire block.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If I'm not mistaken, this is one of the central hubs that connects Reunion's various bases.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If we destroy the communication facility here, we can deliver a crippling blow to their forces in this area.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That would put us one step closer to recapturing the L.G.D. Headquarters.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Your call.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Also, I can't stop thinking about the details of the intel report.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You mean, that part about Reunion's objective not just being the construction of a forward base?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 'Enemies are secretly looking for an extremely high-value target. It is necessary to determine their actions first.'

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What are they doing in the wealthy districts? What kind of high-value target are they trying to find there?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It seems a bit fishy to me as well. According to our previous plans, all the buildings here should already have been evacuated.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If Reunion is planning to kidnap one of the moguls, they probably won't find them here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: When are we going to make our move? Scouting doesn't seem to be Reunion's strong suit, so we can carry out our raid at any time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They're probably used to always being the hunters, not the prey.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Now that it's their turn to be the prey, they'll be hunted down in no time.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let's continue observing them carefully for now. Our priority is to find out what their objectives are, not to engage them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's easy enough to go in and destroy them, but it'll take patience to find out what they're after.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wait! Ch'en, are they about to break the door of that house down?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Has the target already been confirmed? Assemble, quickly!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: To minimize the loss of civilians, huh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Of course! Snipers, take aim!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: It's Lungmen's army! Fall back!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We need to contact...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Snipers! Shoot down that person with the radio equipment! Stop that transmission!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're supposed to be defending the base, so how come they're running away from us? They're up to something!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let's see how far you can run!
